title: AI Fake News Detector
problemStatement: Fake news and misleading information can spread quickly through online platforms.
description: An AI-based system that analyzes news articles and predicts whether the content is likely to be fake or genuine.
objectives: Detect potentially fake news and help users identify misleading information.
howItWorks: The user provides a news article, the system analyzes its content using machine learning techniques, and then displays the prediction.

title: News Verification System
problemStatement: Users often have difficulty verifying whether information in online news articles is trustworthy.
description: A system that analyzes news articles and provides information to help users verify the credibility of the content.
objectives: Help users verify online news and reduce the spread of misinformation.
howItWorks: The system receives a news article, analyzes its content, checks relevant information, and presents verification results.
techStack: Python, Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning

title: Smart Campus Navigation
problemStatement: Students can have difficulty finding classrooms, laboratories, and other locations on a large campus.
description: A navigation system that helps students find different locations within their college campus.
objectives: Make campus navigation easier and reduce the time students spend searching for locations.
howItWorks: The user selects a destination and the system provides a route from the current location to the selected destination.

title: Student Performance Predictor
problemStatement: Students and teachers may find it difficult to identify students who are at risk of poor academic performance.
description: A machine learning system that predicts student academic performance using relevant student data.
objectives: Predict academic performance and help identify areas where students may need support.
howItWorks: Student data is provided to the system, the machine learning model analyzes the data, and a predicted performance result is generated.

title: IoT Smart Waste Management
problemStatement: Traditional waste collection systems may not know when garbage bins are full, leading to inefficient collection.
description: An IoT-based system that monitors garbage levels in waste bins and helps optimize waste collection.
objectives: Improve waste collection efficiency and reduce unnecessary collection trips.
howItWorks: Sensors monitor the garbage level inside bins and send the collected information to the system so that full bins can be identified.
